title: Xiao Bai joins Gui Li; Lu Xueqi is sent south
summary: Xiao Bai tells Gui Li she once saw Soul Revival Magic used to save a man who had lost one hun and three po, so there is hope for his friend while one soul remains. She means the Black Wu Clan of the Shiwan Mountains, which Gui Li has searched for in vain for ten years; she met them two hundred years before her imprisonment, so they existed at least five hundred years ago, and she offers to lead him to them. She asks him to call her Xiao Bai instead of Senior, and learns the monkey's name is Xiao Hui. Jin Ping'er finds their hiding place, hints that Gui Li caused the volcano's eruption, teases him about Bi Yao and his new companion, and leaves; Fen Xiang disciples arrive soon after, led there by her, and are driven off. On Qingyun Mountain, Dao Xuan says rumours of turmoil in Fen Xiang Valley and trouble for Yun Yilan mean the righteous sects cannot stand by; with Pu Hong of Tian Yin Temple he decides to send disciples, and on Shui Yue's word Lu Xueqi is chosen and told to investigate, not act rashly. At Huqi Mountain the Ghost King hears from Bai Hu about the eruption and decides to let Gui Li stir up Fen Xiang while the Ten Thousand Poisons and He Huan sects wear each other down. Elsewhere Hei Mu, a demon shaman of the ancient Wu clan, says the black fire burns again and the day he waits for is near.
